title: Ankara Court Annuls CHP Leadership, Reinstates Kılıçdaroğlu; BIST-100 Drops 6%
detail: In the most dramatic judicial intervention against Turkey's opposition in years, the 36th Ankara Regional Court of Appeal on May 21, 2026, issued an interim measure annulling the November 2023 CHP party congress and removing party chair Özgür Özel and the full party leadership from office. The court ordered former long-time leader Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu — who had been voted out by Özel's faction — reinstated as interim chair. The ruling triggered a 6%+ drop in the BIST-100 stock index as investors reacted to increased political uncertainty. The EU, US State Department, and Council of Europe issued statements calling for the opposition to be allowed to operate freely. Human Rights Watch condemned the decision on May 22, calling it 'another blow to Turkey's battered democracy.' Critics note the timing — Özel had led the CHP to its best electoral performance in 22 years (37.8% in March 2024 local elections, surpassing AKP's 35.5% for the first time). With İmamoğlu still jailed, the ruling represents yet another judicial strike against organized opposition ahead of the 2028 presidential election.

title: EFES-2026 Exercise Concludes; Syria and Libya Join Turkey's Drills in Historic Firsts
detail: Turkey's flagship biennial military exercise EFES-2026 concluded its live-fire phase on approximately May 21, 2026, at training ranges near İzmir along the Aegean coast. Over 10,000 personnel from 50 nations participated at the İzmir Gulf and Doğanbey training ranges, including NATO allies (US, Germany, France, UK) and partners from Azerbaijan, Pakistan, Malaysia, Japan, Sweden, Somalia, and Rwanda. Two historic firsts were recorded: approximately 50 Syrian military personnel participated — the first time the post-Assad Syrian army conducted an exercise outside Syrian territory — and 502 Libyan personnel from both eastern and western factions participated together under a single banner for the first time outside Libya. Turkey framed both Syria and Libya's participation as part of its military advisory and restructuring programs, signaling Ankara's growing role as the primary patron of Syria's post-Assad military establishment.

media.caption: EFES-2026 concludes near İzmir — Syria and Libya join for historic firsts
